audit.whatIsWrong: diff read HARD while diffRating said 6/10 and the final rating line said 'Even matchup'; the level chart also disagreed with the mirror on four of seven rows.
audit.why: Heimerdinger wins 44.2% here — this is a losing lane, not an even one. The mirror set the chart to Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Skill / Skill / Aurora / Skill / Heimerdinger, which is also the packet chart and matches the existing whys text on rows 2, 4 and 5.
audit.corrected: Difficulty 7.5/10 and 'Hard matchup' throughout; chart aligned to the mirror on both layers with ratings moved to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 row was a generic template naming no ultimate, and phases[0] claimed level 1 wins 'against almost everyone' without saying why here.
audit.why: Between Worlds is 140/120/100 and Across the Veil 22/21/20/19/18s — her level-6 dive is only clean because the blink dodges the grenade follow-up. At level 1 she has no blink at all, which is why that stage is Heimerdinger's.
audit.corrected: Level 1 keyed to Twofold Hex's 9s/900 and her missing blink; level 6 keyed to Between Worlds plus Across the Veil's 22s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aurora's blink was attributed to 'Twofold Hex (Blink)' and to her E; the grenade was called 'CH-3X' and 'CH-3X Lightning Grenade'; turret beams were said to slow; her healing passive was never mentioned.
audit.why: Twofold Hex (Q, 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s, 900 range) is a curse missile with a recast — not a blink. Across the Veil (W, 22/21/20/19/18s, 700) is the leap that turns her invisible; The Weirding (E, 15s, 825) hops her backwards. Heimerdinger's E is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (11s flat, 970) — only the direct hit stuns, the splash only slows — and the turret's secondary attack is a pass-through beam with no slow. Spirit Abjuration heals her off every spell she lands.
audit.corrected: Track Across the Veil, not the Q, as the escape; bait it, then land CH-2's direct hit on her landing point. Add Oblivion Orb against Spirit Abjuration.
